gen-gf-gabarito-gf-lato: Lato takes the quiet seat, its wide s curves barely curling in, while Gabarito up top looks drawn with a single marker nib. Their strokes agree, so the page feels like one hand.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: Distinctive Gabarito leads with an s whose spine is as thick as its ends, a marker-drawn look with real character. And LXGW Marker Gothic follows with a bracelet-wide c and a gentle weight shift, so a long page keeps moving without tiring.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-m-plus-2: Gabarito's most striking habit is its single-nib line, with endings left wide and flowing, which gives headings a hand-drawn spark. M PLUS 2 does the quieter job, keeping a steady nib width and a gaping c that make running text feel approachable.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Gabarito leads with an expressive, single-nib look and open endings that feel loose and confident, a bold change from what follows. M PLUS Code Latin reads like neon tubing, with pitcher-mouth c shapes.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Gabarito draws wirelike strokes of one thickness, and its open endings give the headline a distinctive, hand-made feel. But M PLUS Rounded 1c stops its terminals short of curling back, which lets the text settle in beside it.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-manjari: Gabarito brings the personality, a nib-drawn line with endings left open and a distinctive, expressive swagger. Manjari handles the steady work, with unvarying line weight and wide, unclosed curves that make text feel approachable.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-meera-inimai: Approachable Meera Inimai gives the body open-ended curves with room to breathe and a blueprint-like constant line, under Gabarito's expressive nib-drawn heading. The strongest trait is how consistent the strokes feel.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-mina: Contemporary lines run through both fonts, from Gabarito's nib-drawn heading to Mina below. Mina's strokes are as plain as stitched thread outlines, and each small round letter has a generously unclosed curve, so a long passage moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-molengo: Gabarito's heading has no shading at all, just a drawn-with-one-nib line. Molengo sits beneath with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, and its low contrast lets the expressive heading above take the lead.
